rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a wild animal into a domestic one, especially in educational or scientific contexts.

example.english: Scientists spent decades trying to domesticate this species of wild fox.
example.traditional: 科學家用咗幾十年時間馴化呢種野生狐狸。
